Item 1. Business

Generic Biotech Holdings, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on its lead program, GBH-101, for a rare disease indication.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Following a meeting with the applicable regulatory authority, the regulatory authority indicated that it did not consider the Company's proposed primary endpoint appropriate to establish the effectiveness of GBH-101 for the target indication. The Company's ongoing pivotal study will require a revised primary endpoint before it can again be characterized as pivotal or registrational.

Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis

As of December 31, 2025, the Company had cash and cash equivalents of 31.5 million dollars. Based on our current operating plan, we believe our existing cash and cash equivalents raise substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern for at least the next twelve months.
